file_video.title: Video File URL (Direct Download & Clip Extraction)
file_video.description: Direct URL to a video file (.mp4, .mkv, .mov, .webm, etc.) to download and analyze locally. When specified, the Actor downloads the video, extracts its audio, detects salient moments from the audio signal, cuts the video into clips, and provides downloadable trimmed clips.

video_url.title: YouTube Video URL
video_url.description: Valid YouTube video or VOD URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=..., https://youtu.be/...). Used when 'file_video' is not provided.

max_clips.title: Maximum Clips
max_clips.description: Number of top highlight segments to return, sorted by engagement score.

max_length.title: Maximum Clip Length (seconds)
max_length.description: Maximum duration in seconds of each selected highlight clip (including context buffers). Optimized for YouTube Shorts (e.g. 60s).
